storeInfo.name: Lime Rock Cafe
storeInfo.tagline: Classic New England Comfort Food & Modern American Bistro | Comida reconfortante de Nueva Inglaterra y bistró americano

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo o en la calle.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.nameEs: Sopa de Cebolla al Estilo Francés
products.descriptionEs: Caldo rico de res caramelizado a fuego lento, cubierto con pan crujiente y queso Gruyère derretido.
products.descriptionEn: Slow-simmered caramelized beef broth topped with crusty artisanal bread and melted Gruyère cheese.

products.descriptionEs: Alitas crujientes bañadas en nuestra salsa picante secreta de la casa, servidas con aderezo de queso azul y bastones de apio.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy wings tossed in our signature house spicy glaze, served with cool blue cheese dressing and crisp celery sticks.

products.descriptionEs: Calamares tiernos ligeramente empanizados y fritos a la perfección, acompañados de salsa marinara casera y limón fresco.
products.descriptionEn: Tender squid lightly breaded and fried to perfection, served with house-made marinara sauce and fresh lemon wedges.

products.nameEs: Croquetas de Queso de Cabra y Hierbas
products.descriptionEs: Queso de cabra local cremoso con hierbas frescas sobre pan tostado de masa madre, rociado con miel de lavanda.
products.descriptionEn: Creamy local goat cheese infused with fresh herbs on toasted sourdough, drizzled with delicate lavender honey.
Juicy certified Angus beef patty with Vermont cheddar, smoked bacon, crisp lettuce, tomato, and garlic aioli on a toasted brioche bun.

products.nameEs: Sándwich de Pollo a la Parrilla al Pesto
products.descriptionEn: Grilled chicken breast topped with fresh basil pesto, sun-dried tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, and arugula on rustic ciabatta bread.
Crisp romaine lettuce, house garlic croutons, shaved parmesan cheese, and crispy chicken tenders tossed in traditional Caesar dressing.

products.nameEs: Sándwich de Pescado Rebozado Estilo Cerveza
products.descriptionEn: Fresh local fish fillet in artisanal beer batter, fried and served on a rustic roll with creamy coleslaw and house tartar sauce.
Slow-smoked tender pork ribs glazed in our proprietary sweet and smoky barbecue sauce. Served with seasoned fries and coleslaw.

products.nameEs: Risotto de Hongos Silvestres y Trufa
products.descriptionEn: Slow-cooked creamy Arborio rice simmered with sautéed wild forest mushrooms, white truffle oil, and aged Parmigiano-Reggiano.

products.nameEs: Filete de Salmón al Horno con Limón y Eneldo
products.descriptionEn: Pan-seared Atlantic salmon fillet with crispy skin, bright lemon-dill butter sauce, served alongside charred fresh asparagus.

products.nameEs: Pasta Pappardelle con Ragú de Ternera
products.descriptionEn: Wide ribbon fresh pasta tossed in a rich, slow-braised beef short rib red wine ragù and topped with freshly grated parmesan.
Freshly squeezed homemade lemonade infused with a subtle hint of wild lavender blossom syrup.
Local craft IPA brewed right here in Connecticut, featuring crisp citrus notes and a well-balanced hop finish.
Freshly pulled double shot of espresso poured over ice with cold milk and a touch of pure bourbon vanilla bean syrup.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con varias opciones vegetarianas y platos que se pueden preparar sin gluten. Pregunte a su mesero.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer several vegetarian choices and dishes that can be prepared gluten-free. Please ask your server.

faqs.aEs: Aceptamos clientes sin reservación y también aceptamos reservaciones por teléfono para grupos de cualquier tamaño.
faqs.aEn: We warmly welcome walk-ins and also accept phone reservations for parties of any size.

faqs.aEs: Sí, disponemos de un amplio estacionamiento gratuito adyacente al restaurante.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we have ample complimentary parking available adjacent to the restaurant.
